# Tool reference

Every tool of the Gridfinity Layout Tool MCP server, with its inputs. All the tools only compute from their input: they read and change nothing.

## `bin_size_for`: Common bin sizes

Look up the bin size that makers most often gave bins with each label in the Layout Tool, such as "M3 screws". It is a habit, not a fact about the item: use it as a starting point, and size from the item when a label has no common size.

| Input    | Type        | Required | Notes                                                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `labels` | string list | yes      | What each bin holds, as a maker would label it, such as "M3 screws". 1 to 20 items. Each item: up to 24 characters. |

## `drawer_fit`: Fit a drawer

Run the Layout Tool's drawer calculator. Give the inside width and depth of a drawer, and its height when known. Returns the grid of 42 mm units that fits, a tighter half-unit grid when one fits, the spare room, the tallest bins for stacks of 1, 2 and 3, and a link that opens the layout editor at that size.

| Input      | Type   | Required | Notes                            |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `widthMm`  | number | yes      | Inside width, in the unit below. |
| `depthMm`  | number | yes      | Inside depth, in the unit below. |
| `heightMm` | number | no       | Inside height, if known.         |
| `unit`     | string | no       | Default mm. One of `mm`, `in`.   |

## `plan_layout`: Plan a drawer

Plan a whole drawer with the Layout Tool's placement code. Give the measured drawer, or a grid size when there is no measurement, and a bin for each kind of thing to store, in grid units of 42 mm and height units of 7 mm. The app fits the grid, places the bins largest first, puts a bin on layer 2 only where bins below carry it, and sends bins that do not fit to the stash. Returns what it placed and stashed, and a link that opens the plan in the app. The bin sizes are your choice, so present them as a starting point.

| Input             | Type        | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | ----------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`           | string      | no       | The layout name. Up to 64 characters.                                                                                                                 |
| `drawer`          | object      | no       | The inside size of the drawer, as measured. Give this or grid.                                                                                        |
| `drawer.width`    | number      | yes      | Over 0.                                                                                                                                               |
| `drawer.depth`    | number      | yes      | Over 0.                                                                                                                                               |
| `drawer.height`   | number      | no       | Over 0.                                                                                                                                               |
| `drawer.unit`     | string      | yes      | One of `mm`, `cm`, `in`.                                                                                                                              |
| `grid`            | object      | no       | The grid size in units, when there is no measurement. Give this or drawer.                                                                            |
| `grid.width`      | number      | yes      | 0.5 to 50.                                                                                                                                            |
| `grid.depth`      | number      | yes      | 0.5 to 50.                                                                                                                                            |
| `grid.height`     | integer     | no       | The drawer height in height units of 7 mm, if known. 2 to 50.                                                                                         |
| `halfGrid`        | boolean     | no       | With a measured drawer: true fits the grid in half units, as Half-grid mode does, where that fits tighter. A bin in half units turns it on by itself. |
| `categories`      | string list | no       | Category names. Bins of one category share a color. 1 to 20 items. Each item: up to 24 characters.                                                    |
| `bins`            | object list | yes      | The bins to place. Empty for the drawer alone, with its grid and no bins. 0 to 60 items.                                                              |
| `bins[].label`    | string      | yes      | A short label for the bin. Up to 24 characters.                                                                                                       |
| `bins[].items`    | string list | no       | What the bin holds. 0 to 20 items. Each item: up to 48 characters.                                                                                    |
| `bins[].width`    | number      | yes      | Width in grid units of 42 mm, whole or half. 0.5 to 50.                                                                                               |
| `bins[].depth`    | number      | yes      | Depth in grid units of 42 mm, whole or half. 0.5 to 50.                                                                                               |
| `bins[].height`   | integer     | yes      | Height in height units of 7 mm. 2 to 50.                                                                                                              |
| `bins[].category` | string      | no       | One of the category names. Up to 24 characters.                                                                                                       |
| `bins[].layer`    | integer     | no       | 1, the default, for the baseplate; 2 or more to rest on bins below. 1 to 10.                                                                          |
| `bins[].count`    | integer     | no       | How many of this bin. Default 1. 1 to 60.                                                                                                             |

## `print_estimate`: Estimate a print

Estimate filament, print time and filament cost for standard bins with the bin designer's own estimate. Give each bin's size in grid units and height units, and a count. The baseplate is not included.

| Input                       | Type        | Required | Notes                                                             |
| --------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bins`                      | object list | yes      | 1 to 60 items.                                                    |
| `bins[].label`              | string      | no       | Up to 24 characters.                                              |
| `bins[].width`              | number      | yes      | Width in grid units of 42 mm, whole or half. 0.5 to 16.           |
| `bins[].depth`              | number      | yes      | Depth in grid units of 42 mm, whole or half. 0.5 to 16.           |
| `bins[].height`             | integer     | yes      | In height units of 7 mm. 2 to 50.                                 |
| `bins[].count`              | integer     | no       | How many of this bin. Default 1. 1 to 60.                         |
| `printer`                   | object      | no       | The printer's settings, when known. The app's defaults fill gaps. |
| `printer.nozzleMm`          | number      | no       | 0.1 to 2.                                                         |
| `printer.layerHeightMm`     | number      | no       | 0.04 to 1.                                                        |
| `printer.infillPercent`     | number      | no       | 0 to 100.                                                         |
| `printer.filamentCostPerKg` | number      | no       | 0 to 1000.                                                        |

## `split_plan`: Split a baseplate

Split a baseplate for a print bed with the baseplate generator's own planner. Give the grid in units and the bed size. Returns whether the default plate prints in one piece, or its pieces, columns, rows and bed loads.

| Input        | Type   | Required | Notes                                                |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `grid`       | object | yes      | The baseplate grid in units of 42 mm, whole or half. |
| `grid.width` | number | yes      | 0.5 to 50.                                           |
| `grid.depth` | number | yes      | 0.5 to 50.                                           |
| `bed`        | object | yes      | The print bed. Without a depth, the bed is square.   |
| `bed.width`  | number | yes      | Over 0.                                              |
| `bed.depth`  | number | no       | Over 0.                                              |
| `bed.unit`   | string | yes      | One of `mm`, `cm`, `in`.                             |
